business_problem: Xapien needed a more accurate, multilingual due-diligence engine that could process huge amounts of unstructured global data quickly enough to avoid customer wait queues while staying affordable.
solution_summary: Xapien uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Xapien needed a more accurate, multilingual due-diligence engine that could process huge amounts of unstructured global data quickly enough to avoid customer wait queues while staying affordable. Gemini 2.5 Flash handles high-volume parsing tasks such as name normalization and fast report preparation, serving as the compute layer. Gemini 2.5 Pro performs the deeper reasoning needed to summarize risks and keep report accuracy high, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine scales the research engine globally so more simultaneous reports can run without queueing users, serving as the orchestration layer. Gemini Code Assist helps the engineering team prototype new platform capabilities in hours rather than days, serving as the serving layer.

evidence_quotes: Xapien transformed its due-diligence platform with Google Cloud, cutting wait times and achieving 97% accuracy with Gemini models.
For high-volume tasks, the team uses Gemini 2.5 Flash.
